primaryTextChecks.text: He struck them from Aroer until you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and to Abelcheramim, with a very great slaughter. So the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

contextChecks.before: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hand.
contextChecks.after: Jephthah came to Mizpah to his house; and behold, his daughter came out to meet him with tambourines and with dances. She was his only child. Besides her he had neither son nor daughter.
